propositions: An optional [s3] extra must be declared in pyproject.toml with git-remote-s3>=0.3.2 as its dependency
require_s3_helper() must verify both that the git-remote-s3 console script exists on PATH and that the installed distribution version is at least 0.3.2

require_s3_helper() must raise OptionalDependencyError with actionable message (pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]') when the script is missing, distribution metadata is absent, version is older than 0.3.2, or version string is unparseable
The version comparison must use stdlib-only parsing (split on dots, extract leading digits as ints, compare tuple) without packaging or git_remote_s3 imports
guard_import("git_remote_s3", extra="s3") must yield a missing-extra error with the standard one-line install hint message
Unit tests must cover happy path (0.3.2+), missing script, missing metadata, old version (0.2.9), newer versions (0.4.0, 0.3.2.post1), and unparseable versions (unknown)
